decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1099-001, 1099-002, 1099-003, 1099-004, 1099-005, 1099-006, 1099-007, 1099-008, 1099-009, 1099-010, 1099-02-00, Received: 02/05/2017. 1099-02-01.2, 1099-02-02 Rev A, 1099-02-03 Rev B, 1099-02-04 Rev C, 1099-02-05 Rev A, 1099-02-06 Rev D, 1099-02-07 Rev A, Received: 20/06/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing roof of the building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the side dormer window shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Enlargement of roof with side and rear roof dormers and addition of roof lights to the house
